test_basic_fail_expected: test that a FAIL_EXPECTED target passes when its action fails as expected
test_error_unexpected_pass: test that a FAIL_EXPECTED target errors when its action unexpectedly succeeds
test_multiple_actions_skip: test that subsequent actions are skipped after the first FAIL_EXPECTED action fails
test_quitquick_no_early_exit: test that FAIL_EXPECTED targets do not cause early exit on expected failure with -q flag
test_quitquick_error_early_exit: test that FAIL_EXPECTED targets cause early exit when they unexpectedly pass with -q flag
